categories.title: Discovery & Search
categories.description: Find, index, inspect, and resume historical sessions across projects or agents.

categories.title: Viewing & Replay
categories.description: Turn raw session logs into readable, auditable, or shareable timelines.

categories.title: Export, Migration & Handoff
categories.description: Move session content between files, machines, clients, or agent formats.

categories.title: Session Management
categories.description: Run, group, switch, monitor, or preserve multiple active coding-agent sessions.

categories.title: Analytics & Cost
categories.description: Analyze activity, tokens, cost, and recurring patterns from local session data.

projects.name: Agent Sessions
projects.summary: Local-first macOS app for browsing, searching, analyzing, and resuming coding-agent session history.
projects.best_for: Developers who want one local visual history across many coding agents.

projects.name: Codex History
projects.summary: Read-only CLI for searching, inspecting, and exporting locally stored Codex sessions.
projects.best_for: Terminal users who need conservative, scriptable access to Codex history.

projects.name: Codex History Viewer
projects.summary: VS Code extension for searching, organizing, inspecting, and resuming Codex and Claude Code sessions.
projects.best_for: VS Code users who want session history integrated with their editor workflow.

projects.name: sessions
projects.summary: Unified full-text search, resume, MCP recall, and usage reporting over multiple coding-agent histories.
projects.best_for: Developers who want searchable history to double as agent-accessible project memory.

projects.name: Claude Code Trace
projects.summary: Cross-platform viewer for browsing, searching, and live-tailing Claude Code JSONL session logs.
projects.best_for: Local debugging and real-time inspection of Claude Code sessions.

projects.name: claude-replay
projects.summary: Converts coding-agent transcripts into self-contained interactive HTML replays with optional redaction.
projects.best_for: Sharing, teaching, documenting, or reviewing agent sessions without video capture.

projects.name: Recensa
projects.summary: Self-hosted local web viewer that indexes Claude Code transcripts for reading, search, replay, and audit.
projects.best_for: Private browser-based review of a large local Claude Code transcript archive.

projects.name: Agent Session Resume
projects.summary: Reusable agent skill and helper scripts for reconstructing prior work and continuing from historical transcripts.
projects.best_for: Cross-agent handoffs where the next agent must recover unfinished work safely.

projects.name: Codex Session Export
projects.summary: Terminal-native tool for selecting, filtering, and exporting local Codex JSONL sessions to Markdown.
projects.best_for: Codex users who need fine-grained control over what enters an exported transcript.

projects.name: Codex Session Exporter
projects.summary: CLI for exporting Codex sessions to Markdown, HTML, or portable bundles and importing bundles elsewhere.
projects.best_for: Moving complete Codex sessions between clients or machines while preserving metadata.

projects.name: UniSessions
projects.summary: SDK-first converter for moving sessions among coding-agent formats and exporting training or trace datasets.
projects.best_for: Developers building migration, recall, or dataset pipelines across agent formats.

projects.name: Agent Deck
projects.summary: Terminal command center for grouping, switching, forking, and monitoring active coding-agent sessions.
projects.best_for: Developers coordinating many concurrent terminal-agent sessions across projects.

projects.name: CCManager
projects.summary: TUI for managing multiple coding-agent sessions across projects and Git worktrees without requiring tmux.
projects.best_for: Developers who want worktree-aware multi-agent session control in one terminal UI.

projects.name: ccusage
projects.summary: CLI that reads local coding-agent usage records and reports token consumption and estimated cost.
projects.best_for: Teams or individuals comparing local token usage and cost across many agent CLIs.

projects.name: Clawd Insights
projects.summary: Local-first dashboard for session timelines, AI-generated reviews, activity analysis, and analysis-cost tracking.
projects.best_for: macOS users who want qualitative reviews and timeline analytics over local sessions.
